title: UNHINGED: Democrat Rep Claims ICE 'MURDERING' People, Blames GOP for DHS Shutdown Mess | Next News Network
text:
Colorado Democrat Rep. Jason Crow went completely off the rails during a Fox News appearance Wednesday, making the absolutely insane claim that Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents are "murdering" people while simultaneously blaming Republicans for the ongoing Department of Homeland Security funding battle.
During his appearance on "The Will Cain Show," Crow tried to justify why Democrats' current stance on the DHS shutdown is somehow different from their previous criticism of government shutdowns. His reasoning? According to this unhinged leftist, "You have ICE and CBP murdering" people.
Let that sink in, patriots. A sitting member of Congress just accused our brave border patrol agents and ICE officers of murder on national television. These are the same heroes who risk their lives daily to protect Americans from drug cartels, human traffickers, and dangerous criminals pouring across our southern border.
Democrat Hypocrisy on Full Display
But Crow's delusional rant doesn't stop there. The Colorado Democrat somehow managed to blame Republicans for the DHS funding crisis while defending his party's sudden flip-flop on government shutdowns. Remember when Democrats screamed that ANY government shutdown was unacceptable? Apparently, those rules don't apply when it serves their radical anti-border security agenda.
"This is different from what Democrats have criticized in the past," Crow claimed, desperately trying to justify his party's blatant hypocrisy.
What we're witnessing is the Democrat Party's continued assault on law enforcement and border security. They can't defend their failed policies, so they resort to outrageous lies and character assassination against the men and women who serve our nation.
Under President Trump's leadership, ICE and Border Patrol are finally being empowered to do their jobs again after four years of being handcuffed by the Biden regime. The massive deportation operation is working exactly as promised, and Democrats are absolutely losing their minds.
How long will Americans tolerate these radical Democrats slandering our law enforcement heroes while our communities suffer from their open border policies? The 2026 midterms can't come soon enough to hold these extremists accountable.
